outcome: Quantitative expression of ghrelin (GHSR) antibodies in placental tissue
cohort: Sixty pregnant women aged 20-35 years, divided into a group with gestational diabetes (n=30) and a control group without diabetes (n=30).
finding: Ghrelin expression was significantly elevated in the gestational diabetes group compared to the control group, and fetal body weight was significantly increased in the gestational diabetic group.
cross-section timing: At birth (placental samples and newborn body weight collected after delivery)
